title.zh: 在AI攻克数学问题的一年，Anthropic可能刚解决了最大难题
title.en: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest

summary.zh: Anthropic一名数学家称，其利用AI证明了著名的黎曼猜想，但验证仍需时间。该说法若属实将是数学界的重大突破，目前尚待同行审查。
summary.en: A mathematician at Anthropic claims he used AI to prove the famed Riemann hypothesis, though verification will take time. If confirmed, it would mark a major mathematical breakthrough; the claim awaits peer review.

reports.title: In a year of AI solving maths problems, Anthropic may have just solved the biggest
Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

title.zh: Levent Alpöge 宣称证明广义黎曼猜想
title.en: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]

summary.zh: 数学家 Levent Alpöge 在个人网站发布一份 PDF 文稿，宣称证明了广义黎曼猜想，随即在数学界与网络社区引发热议。该文稿尚未经过同行评审，其证明是否成立仍有待专家检验。
summary.en: Mathematician Levent Alpöge has posted a PDF claiming a proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis, drawing wide attention online. The manuscript has not been peer-reviewed, and experts have yet to verify whether the argument holds.

reports.title: Levent Alpöge claims proof of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis [pdf]

title.zh: Anthropic正式登陆纳斯达克
title.en: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street

summary.zh: Anthropic正式上市，以“ANT”为代码在纳斯达克开始交易，开盘价111.50美元，高于每股83美元的发行价。此次上市距其公布IPO计划约一个月，发行价对应公司估值约1.5万亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic has officially gone public, beginning trading on Nasdaq under ticker “ANT” at $111.50 per share, above its $83 IPO price. The listing comes nearly a month after the company announced plans to go public; the IPO price valued it at about $1.5 trillion.

reports.title: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street

title.zh: 科技股抛售拖累市场，Anthropic股价下滑
title.en: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide

summary.zh: 科技股抛售令美国股市承压，标普500指数与道琼斯工业平均指数跌入回调区间。Anthropic股价下滑进一步加剧市场压力。
summary.en: A tech stock sell-off weighed on US markets, pushing the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average into correction territory. Anthropic shares also slid, adding to the pressure.

reports.title: Tech stock sell-off drags markets down as Anthropic shares slide
Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off

title.zh: 独家：消息人士称美国SEC调查聚焦英伟达会计问题
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社援引消息人士报道，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）正在调查英伟达的会计问题。该调查聚焦其账务处理，具体细节尚未披露。
summary.en: Sources told Reuters that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Nvidia's accounting. The probe focuses on the company's accounting practices; further details were not disclosed.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say - Reuters

title.zh: Frostbite：由 AI 发现、设计并验证的全新 CPU 架构
title.en: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

summary.zh: Architect Labs 发布博客，介绍名为 Frostbite 的全新 CPU 架构，称其架构探索、设计与验证均由 AI 完成。该文在 Hacker News 上引发热议，获得 600 余点与数百条评论。
summary.en: Architect Labs published a blog post introducing Frostbite, a new CPU architecture it says was discovered, designed and verified by AI. The claim drew heavy discussion on Hacker News, where the post earned over 600 points and hundreds of comments.

reports.title: Frostbite: A new CPU architecture discovered, designed and verified by AI

title.zh: OpenSSL 的 EVP_EncodeBlock() 存在缓冲区溢出漏洞（CVE-2026-121481，CVSS 9.8）
title.en: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8)

summary.zh: OpenSSL 披露 EVP_EncodeBlock() 中的缓冲区溢出漏洞，编号 CVE-2026-121481，CVSS 评分 9.8，属严重级别。相关修复已通过 PR 提交，建议用户尽快关注并升级。
summary.en: OpenSSL disclosed a buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock(), tracked as CVE-2026-121481 with a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating critical severity. A fix has been submitted via pull request, and users should monitor advisories and upgrade promptly.

reports.title: OpenSSL: Buffer overflow in EVP_EncodeBlock() (CVE-2026-121481, CVSS 9.8)

title.zh: 英伟达股价暴跌14%，创2008年金融危机以来最长周线连跌纪录
title.en: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

summary.zh: 英伟达股价本周暴跌14%，创下2008年金融危机以来最长周线连跌纪录。该公司曾为全球市值最高企业，目前市值排名第四，落后于苹果、微软和Alphabet。
summary.en: Nvidia shares fell 14% this week, marking their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis. Once the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia now ranks fourth behind Apple, Microsoft and Alphabet.

reports.title: Nvidia stock plunges 14%, wraps up longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis

title.zh: 美联储理事库克为10月异见投票辩护：通胀压力紧迫，利率需更快上调
title.en: Fed Governor Cook Defends October Dissent: Inflation Pressure Is Urgent, Rates Need to Rise Faster

summary.zh: 美联储理事库克为其10月议息会议上的异见投票辩护，称通胀压力紧迫，利率需要更快上调。她主张更激进的加息路径。
summary.en: Federal Reserve Governor Cook defended her dissenting vote at the October policy meeting, saying inflation pressure is urgent and interest rates need to rise faster. She advocated a more aggressive rate path.

reports.title: 美联储理事库克为10月异见投票辩护：通胀压力紧迫，利率需更快上调 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 网络安全行业或迎史上最大并购：CrowdStrike洽购Zscaler，合并后市值或达2650亿美元
title.en: Cybersecurity Industry May See Largest-Ever M&A: CrowdStrike in Talks to Acquire Zscaler, Combined Market Value Could Reach $265 Billion

summary.zh: 据报道，网络安全公司CrowdStrike正就收购同行Zscaler展开洽谈。若交易达成，将成为网络安全行业史上规模最大的并购案，合并后公司市值预计约为2650亿美元。
summary.en: CrowdStrike is reportedly in talks to acquire fellow cybersecurity firm Zscaler. If completed, the deal would be the largest M&A in the cybersecurity industry's history, with the combined company valued at roughly $265 billion.

reports.title: 网络安全行业或迎史上最大并购：CrowdStrike洽购Zscaler，合并后市值或达2650亿美元 - 华尔街见闻
Zscaler stock jumps 18% on report that CrowdStrike in talks to buy security vendor

title.zh: Thinking Machines 发布 Inkling 2 Mini
title.en: Inkling 2 Mini

summary.zh: AI 公司 Thinking Machines 在其官网发布新品 Inkling 2 Mini，具体技术细节尚未在页面摘要中呈现。该消息在 Hacker News 引发热议，获得约 727 点热度与 124 条评论。
summary.en: AI company Thinking Machines announced Inkling 2 Mini on its official news page, with technical details not yet visible in the listing. The item drew heavy attention on Hacker News, gathering roughly 727 points and 124 comments.

reports.title: Inkling 2 Mini

title.zh: 语言模型能够重写自身权重
title.en: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

summary.zh: 一篇 arXiv 预印本论文提出，语言模型可以重写自身权重，从而在无需外部训练的情况下实现自我修改。该论文在 Hacker News 上引发热议，获得 345 点、112 条评论，讨论主要集中在安全性与可控性。
summary.en: An arXiv preprint argues that language models can rewrite their own weights, enabling self-modification without external training. The paper drew 345 points and 112 comments on Hacker News, with discussion centering on safety and control.

reports.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights

title.zh: 全球市场抛售潮持续蔓延
title.en: The snowballing selloff in global markets - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透报道称，全球市场出现不断扩大的抛售潮。报道未提供更多细节，但标题显示跌势正在蔓延。
summary.en: Reuters reports a snowballing selloff across global markets. Few details were provided, but the headline signals that the downturn is spreading.

reports.title: The snowballing selloff in global markets - Reuters

title.zh: Signal 阻止 Gemini 与 Siri AI 读取屏幕内容
title.en: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

summary.zh: Signal 正在限制 Android 和 iOS 设备上的截屏功能，以防 AI 代理读取用户消息等数据。该公司认为，操作系统内置的代理式 AI 通过分析屏幕信息了解用户，正在削弱其独立保障隐私的能力。
summary.en: Signal is restricting screenshots on Android and iOS to stop AI agents from reading users’ messages and other data. The company says operating-system agentic AI that analyzes on-screen information undermines its ability to independently guarantee privacy.

reports.title: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen

title.zh: Signal 呼吁限制移动操作系统中的 AI 代理抓取数据
title.en: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

summary.zh: Signal 发布博客文章，主张移动操作系统应限制 AI 代理访问并抓取用户数据，以保护隐私。文章指出，在平台层面截取数据可能绕过端到端加密，并呼吁在系统设计中为这类代理设定明确的权限边界。
summary.en: Signal published a blog post arguing that mobile operating systems should restrict AI agents from capturing user data on devices. It warns that platform-level data capture can bypass end-to-end encryption and calls for clear permission limits on such agents.

reports.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data

title.zh: 加州调查英伟达芯片出口是否流向中国
title.en: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

summary.zh: 加州总检察长向英伟达发出调查传票，调查其先进芯片出口是否违反美国限制流入中国，并称相关丑闻“亮起红灯”。此事发生在联合创始人兼长期CEO黄仁勋离任后。
summary.en: California Attorney General Rob Bonta subpoenaed Nvidia as part of a probe into whether its advanced chip exports ended up in China in violation of US restrictions. The investigation follows a scandal that led co-founder and longtime CEO Jensen Huang to depart.

reports.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China

title.zh: Google 被指施压 OEM 厂商抵制 GrapheneOS 与 bootloader 解锁
title.en: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

summary.zh: GrapheneOS 称 Google 正施压 OEM 厂商，限制解锁 bootloader 并阻碍安装该隐私系统。此事涉及 Android 设备控制权、用户自由与安全生态。
summary.en: GrapheneOS says Google is pressuring Android OEMs to restrict bootloader unlocking and block the privacy-focused OS. The dispute raises concerns over device ownership, user freedom, and platform control.

reports.title: Google is pushing OEMs against GrapheneOS and bootloader unlocking

title.zh: PostgreSQL 19 正式发布
title.en: PostgreSQL 19

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 19 版本已发布，官方在 postgresql.org 公布了完整发布说明。该消息在 Hacker News 上获得 380 点热度与 28 条评论讨论。
summary.en: PostgreSQL 19 has been released, with official release notes published on postgresql.org. The announcement drew 380 points and 28 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: PostgreSQL 19

title.zh: 苹果或正开发可操控Mac的自有AI智能体
title.en: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

summary.zh: 苹果可能正在开发可操控Mac的自有AI智能体，或与Meta Muse、Instinct、Claude和OpenAI Dots等产品竞争。相关消息尚属传闻，具体细节未获确认。
summary.en: Apple may be developing its own AI agent capable of operating a Mac, potentially competing with Meta Muse, Instinct, Claude and OpenAI Dots. The report is based on apparent indications, not confirmed details.

reports.title: Apple may be developing its own AI agent that runs your Mac

title.zh: Mac 版 Gemini 现已可操控你的电脑
title.en: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

summary.zh: 谷歌为 macOS 版 Gemini 应用加入“电脑使用”功能，可跨本地文件、桌面应用和网页完成多步骤任务。官方称其可用于加速工作流、填写表单、制作演示文稿和发布商品信息。
summary.en: Google’s Gemini app for macOS now supports computer use, letting it complete multi-step tasks across local files, desktop apps, and the web. Google says it can speed up workflows, fill forms, create presentations, and list items for sale.

reports.title: Gemini on Mac can now use your computer

title.zh: 世界法院认定缅甸军队杀害数千罗兴亚人，裁决仍在进行
title.en: World Court finds Myanmar forces killed thousands of Rohingya, ruling ongoing - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，世界法院认定缅甸军队杀害了数千名罗兴亚人。相关裁决仍在进行，案件后续审理受到关注。
summary.en: Reuters reports that the World Court has found Myanmar forces killed thousands of Rohingya. The ruling is still ongoing, with further proceedings expected.

reports.title: World Court finds Myanmar forces killed thousands of Rohingya, ruling ongoing - Reuters

title.zh: 法国警察因殴打音乐制作人泽克勒被判刑，法院认定种族主义为加重情节
title.en: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler

summary.zh: 法国法院判处多名警察因2020年殴打黑人音乐制作人米歇尔·泽克勒有罪，并认定种族主义为加重情节。该案曾引发法国社会对警察暴力和种族歧视的广泛抗议。
summary.en: A French court has sentenced police officers for the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler, ruling that racism was an aggravating circumstance. The case had sparked widespread protests in France over police violence and racial discrimination.

reports.title: French police officers sentenced for beating of music producer Michel Zecler
French police officers found guilty of racist assault on black music producer

title.zh: 我再也不会购买 Framework 硬件
title.en: I'll never buy Framework hardware again

summary.zh: 一篇题为《我再也不会购买 Framework 硬件》的博客文章在 Hacker News 引发热议，获得 765 分和 551 条评论。原文正文未提供，无法概括其具体论点。
summary.en: A blog post titled “I’ll never buy Framework hardware again” is drawing discussion on Hacker News, with 765 points and 551 comments. The article text was not provided, so its specific arguments cannot be summarized.

reports.title: I'll never buy Framework hardware again

title.zh: 为何 iOS 上至今没有非 WebKit 内核浏览器
title.en: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

summary.zh: Mozilla 发文解释，尽管欧盟《数字市场法案》要求开放浏览器引擎，苹果的合规规则仍设置重重门槛，使 iOS 上始终未出现非 WebKit 内核浏览器。文章批评这些限制削弱竞争与用户选择。
summary.en: In a Mozilla blog post, the organization explains why no non-WebKit browsers exist on iOS, arguing that Apple's DMA compliance rules impose barriers that deter rivals from shipping alternative engines. The post criticizes the limits on competition and user choice.

reports.title: Why there are still no non-WebKit browsers on iOS

title.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋风波持续，公司发布财报并停止对华销售H200芯片
title.en: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

summary.zh: 英伟达在CEO黄仁勋被罢免风波持续之际发布最新财报，业绩增长稳健并称好景将继续。公司同时表示将停止在中国销售H200芯片，并拒绝了一些呼吁。
summary.en: Nvidia reported healthy growth and forecast continued good times amid fallout from CEO Jensen Huang’s ouster. The chipmaker also said it will stop selling H200 chips in China and dismissed some calls.

reports.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues

title.zh: 热拉尔·德帕迪约与法国作家因性指控接受调查
title.en: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations

summary.zh: 法国司法部门已对演员热拉尔·德帕迪约和一名法国作家展开调查，此举源于去年针对“性性质指控”提出的投诉。案件具体细节尚未公布。
summary.en: French judicial authorities have opened an investigation into actor Gérard Depardieu and a French author following a complaint filed last year over “allegations of a sexual nature.” Details of the case have not been released.

reports.title: Gérard Depardieu and French author investigated over sexual allegations

title.zh: 美国食肉性螺旋蝇病例激增，牧场主保持警惕
title.en: Flesh-eating screwworm cases surge in US, keeping ranchers on alert

summary.zh: 美国食肉性螺旋蝇病例激增，引发牧场主警惕。该寄生虫可侵食牲畜和野生动物组织，可能造成动物健康与农业损失。相关部门和养殖者正加强监测。
summary.en: Cases of flesh-eating screwworm are surging in the United States, prompting ranchers to remain on alert. The parasite can infest livestock and wildlife, raising concerns about animal health and agricultural losses. Authorities and producers are monitoring the situation.

reports.title: Flesh-eating screwworm cases surge in US, keeping ranchers on alert - Reuters

title.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点
title.en: US 10-year Treasury yield falls 10 basis points

summary.zh: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点。该变动反映市场对利率预期和避险情绪的最新调整。
summary.en: The US 10-year Treasury yield fell 10 basis points. The move reflects the latest shift in rate expectations and market sentiment.

reports.title: 美国10年期国债收益率下跌10个基点 - 第一财经

title.zh: “虚弱头晕”：秘密的ICE强制喂食手段终结古巴父亲绝食
title.en: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike

summary.zh: 一名在得克萨斯州ICE拘留中心的古巴寻求庇护者称，秘密强制喂食手段迫使他结束绝食，并导致他虚弱头晕。他向《卫报》表示，若不吃常规食物，就会被插管喂食；恢复进食五天后仍感不适。
summary.en: A Cuban asylum seeker held in an ICE facility in Texas says secret force-feeding tactics ended his hunger strike and left him weak and dizzy. He told the Guardian that unless he ate regular food, officials would insert a feeding tube.

reports.title: ‘Weak and dizzy’: the secretive ICE force-feeding tactics that ended a Cuban father’s hunger strike

title.zh: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？| 电厂 - 界面新闻
title.en: What Has BYD Done in Japan? | Power Plant - Jiemian.com

summary.zh: 界面新闻“电厂”栏目梳理比亚迪在日本市场的布局与动作。文章围绕其进入日本后的业务推进展开，具体细节需以原文报道为准。
summary.en: Jiemian.com's "Power Plant" column examines BYD's activities and market moves in Japan. The article looks at the company's business expansion there; details should be read in the original report.

reports.title: 比亚迪在日本都做了些什么？ | 电厂 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 加州沿海社区因多年来最大海浪来袭进入警戒
title.en: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state

summary.zh: 加州沿海社区本周处于警戒状态，接连的低压系统带来强劲涌浪和超过9米的大浪，多地发布海岸灾害警报。上周末海滩和码头关闭，美国国家海洋和大气管理局浮标记录到超过30英尺的浪高。
summary.en: California coastal communities were on alert as powerful swells and waves over 9 metres triggered hazard warnings. Beaches and piers closed last weekend after large waves hit the coastline, with NOAA buoys recording heights above 30 feet.

reports.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state

title.zh: 新南威尔士州吸电子烟者失去意识住院，卫生部门发布警告
title.en: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales

summary.zh: 澳大利亚新南威尔士州三名使用特定电子烟后失去意识并住院的人，检测出未受监管的麻醉剂依托咪酯。卫生部门发布公共警告，提醒电子烟液体可能含有该药物。
summary.en: Three people in New South Wales were hospitalised after losing consciousness following use of certain vapes and tested positive for etomidate, an unregulated anaesthetic. NSW Health issued a public warning about vape liquids containing the drug.

reports.title: Vape users hospitalised after losing consciousness, prompting public health warning in New South Wales

title.zh: 伊拉克大学将男教授调离女生课堂 引发数周抗议
title.en: Iraq university’s removal of male professors teaching women sparks weeks of protests

summary.zh: 伊拉克南部卡迪西亚大学禁止男教授教授女学生，过去两周多达400名女性参与抗议，要求教授返校。活动人士批评此举是该国滑向类似塔利班式性别隔离的信号。
summary.en: Al-Qadisiyah University in southern Iraq has removed male professors from classes teaching female students, prompting up to 400 women to protest over two weeks for their return. Activists criticize the move as a sign of Taliban-like gender segregation.

reports.title: Iraq university’s removal of male professors teaching women sparks weeks of protests

title.zh: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷
title.en: Invesco Great Wall's Li Haiwei: AI Remains the Long-Term Theme, but Earnings Will Decide the Tech Rally

summary.zh: 景顺长城基金经理黎海威表示，AI仍是市场长期主线，但科技板块后续走势最终取决于企业盈利能否兑现，投资者应关注业绩验证而非单纯概念炒作。
summary.en: Invesco Great Wall fund manager Li Haiwei said AI remains the market's long-term investment theme, but the tech sector's next move will hinge on whether companies can deliver actual earnings, urging investors to focus on results rather than hype.

reports.title: 景顺长城黎海威：AI长期主线不变，但决定科技行情的还是盈利答卷 - 第一财经

title.zh: 新州调查：心脏异常婴儿在非医疗自由分娩后“没有机会”
title.en: Baby born with heart abnormalities ‘didn’t have a chance’ after non-medical free birth, NSW inquest hears

summary.zh: 新南威尔士州验尸官调查获悉，四名婴儿在自由分娩或家中分娩后死亡，其中一名心脏异常婴儿因未接受医疗护理而“没有机会”。调查认为，常规检查和随访本可能挽救他们的生命。
summary.en: A NSW coronial inquest heard that four babies who died after free or home births might have survived with routine checks and follow-up. One baby born with heart abnormalities after a non-medical free birth “didn’t have a chance.” The deaths occurred in the northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024.

reports.title: Baby born with heart abnormalities ‘didn’t have a chance’ after non-medical free birth, NSW inquest hears

title.zh: 田嶋表示世界杯巴洛贡红牌争议促使他竞选国际足联主席
title.en: Tashima says Balogun red-card row at World Cup pushed him to run for FIFA presidency - Reuters

summary.zh: 田嶋称，世界杯期间巴洛贡红牌引发的争议促使他决定竞选国际足联主席。路透社报道了其表态。
summary.en: Tashima said the controversy over Balogun's red card at the World Cup pushed him to run for FIFA presidency, Reuters reported.

reports.title: Tashima says Balogun red-card row at World Cup pushed him to run for FIFA presidency - Reuters

title.zh: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记
title.en: An Abandoned Resort Paradise by the Black Sea | Caucasus Notes

summary.zh: 财新刊发“高加索散记”系列文章，记述黑海沿岸一处被废弃的度假胜地，通过游记形式呈现当地昔日繁华与今日凋敝的反差。
summary.en: Caixin publishes a travel essay in its Caucasus Notes series on an abandoned resort area along the Black Sea coast, contrasting its past heyday with its present decay.

reports.title: 黑海边被抛弃的度假天堂｜高加索散记 - 财新

title.zh: AI 可能破解了数学中最重要的难题
title.en: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics

summary.zh: 有报道称，AI 可能解决了数学界最重要的问题——黎曼猜想；人类为此已努力167年。若成立，这将是数学史上的里程碑，但相关结论仍需严格验证。文章值得深入阅读，以厘清AI究竟做了什么、证据是否充分，以及这一突破的真正边界。
summary.en: A report suggests AI may have solved the Riemann hypothesis, a problem humans have pursued for 167 years. If validated, it would be a landmark in mathematics. The piece is worth reading to understand what the AI actually did, how strong the evidence is, and what limits remain.

title.zh: 独立数学家认定：AI 给出的黎曼猜想证明几乎可以肯定成立
title.en: The AI Riemann hypothesis proof is almost certainly true, independent mathematicians attest

summary.zh: 黎曼猜想是数学界最重要的未解难题。据称一项由 AI 给出的证明已通过独立数学家的核验，验证工作接近完成，他们判断该证明几乎可以肯定成立。若最终通过正式同行评议，这将是数学与人工智能交叉领域的里程碑，同时也引出如何信任机器证明的新问题。
summary.en: The Riemann hypothesis is the most important unsolved problem in mathematics. Independent mathematicians say their verification of a claimed AI-produced proof is nearly complete, and that the argument is almost certainly correct. If it survives formal peer review, the result would be a milestone at the intersection of mathematics and artificial intelligence, and would raise fresh questions about how machine-generated proofs should be trusted.

title.zh: 黎曼猜想证明出现相互竞争的主张
title.en: Dueling claims of Riemann hypothesis proofs emerge

summary.zh: 数学界最著名的难题——黎曼猜想——据称出现AI辅助证明，引发轰动；仅数小时后，又有人提出第二份证明主张。两方说法尚待专业审查，目前不能视为定论。事件凸显AI参与数学研究的速度与争议，也提醒读者关注证明验证机制。值得深入阅读，以厘清究竟发生了什么。
summary.en: A purported AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis, math’s most famous open problem, has drawn widespread attention; within hours, a second proof claim appeared. Neither claim should be treated as established until expert review. The episode highlights both the speed of AI in mathematical research and the importance of verification. It is worth reading to understand what was actually announced and how the claims differ.

title.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆的欧盟协议只是起点
title.en: Andy Burnham’s EU deal is only a start

summary.zh: 曼彻斯特市长伯纳姆与欧盟达成的地方层面协议，被视为英欧关系回暖的一个信号。但文章指出，真正的难题在于能否把这一安排扩展到更多地区与政策领域。作者梳理了其中的政治与技术障碍，值得关心英国地方外交与英欧关系走向的读者细读。
summary.en: Greater Manchester’s mayor has struck a deal with Brussels, and this piece argues it is a promising but limited first step. Widening the arrangement to other regions and policy areas will prove far harder than securing the original agreement. Worth reading for what it reveals about devolved diplomacy and the fragile thaw in UK–EU relations.

title.zh: “我精通了欺骗”：一名复饮酗酒者的秘密生活——播客
title.en: ‘I perfected deception’: My secret life as a relapsed alcoholic – podcast

summary.zh: 作者讲述自己在戒酒11年后再度酗酒，并如何向所有人隐瞒，甚至包括丈夫。文章剖析成瘾复发背后的羞耻、欺骗与自我合理化机制。值得深入阅读，因为它呈现了复发并非简单失败，而是一种隐秘而持续的心理过程。
summary.en: The author describes relapsing after 11 years sober and hiding it from everyone, including her husband. She examines how shame and deception can sustain addiction. It is worth reading for its candid account of relapse and the secret life it creates.
